ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course is for students in the Springfield cohort. The online course begins June 29 and ends August 21. The course will also include two or three face-to-face class sessions at the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. The first site-based class will be held Monday, June 29 from 6:00 to 9:00 PM in the Radio Station Building (WUIS) in room 22. The email address for the instructor is jhelton2@uiuc.edu
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $372.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
